drivingQuestion: How can R' Ḥanina say he never saw a hide burned when burned bulls and goats are burned with hides?
outcomeNote: The answer comes in the next unit (sugya371).

segments.he: אָמַר רַבִּי חֲנִינָא סְגַן הַכֹּהֲנִים כּוּ׳. וְלֹא?! הֲרֵי פָּרִים הַנִּשְׂרָפִים וּשְׂעִירִים הַנִּשְׂרָפִים!
segments.en: § The mishna teaches: «Rabbi Ḥanina, the deputy High Priest, said:» In all my days, I never saw a hide going out to the place of burning. The Gemara challenges: «And» is it so that he did «not» see? «Aren’t there bulls that are burned and goats that are burned» together with their hides as a matter of course?
